annotations.title: Stock and crypto returns by market regime

description: How has this stock or crypto typically done in markets like today's? Returns, for up to 20 stock or crypto symbols, each one's typical return and how often it rose over 1 to 12 months when the period started in the current regime, as historical odds. A symbol outside coverage comes back as not covered, never as an error. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Settled figures, updated after each US close (coins daily). The same figures as the symbol's page on regimecard.com. Useful when an agent needs stock returns by market regime or crypto returns by market regime for a watchlist or a portfolio.

symbols.description: Stock or crypto symbols, for example ["NVDA", "XLK", "BTC"]. At most 20. Upper or lower case. Repeats are answered once.

items.description: One stock, ETF or crypto symbol.
